title: 烫金文件怎么设计才不容易出问题？

seo.title: 烫金文件怎么设计才不容易出问题？

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答设计师、印前人员、电商包装客户关于烫金文件、专色、线宽、反白字、套准、出血、压痕避让等问题。

## Reddit 英文短评版

Keep the foil artwork as a separate vector spot-color layer.

Avoid extremely thin lines, very small reversed text and foil areas too close to folds or trim edges. If multiple foil colors are used, allow for registration tolerance. A design that looks good on screen may not be stable in foil stamping.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Many foil stamping problems start from artwork design.

For production, the foil area should be prepared as a separate spot-color vector layer. Extremely thin lines, small reverse text, sharp isolated dots and foil areas too close to crease or trim lines can create problems during stamping.

Recommended artwork checks:

1. Separate foil layer

1. Vector artwork

1. Minimum line width confirmed with the printer

1. Avoid small reverse text

1. Avoid foil too close to fold/crease lines

1. Allow registration tolerance for embossing or multi-foil work

1. Test both fine detail and solid areas

Good foil production is not only a material issue. Artwork, die making and process tolerance matter.

## 知乎中文科普版

很多烫金问题，其实在设计文件阶段就埋下了。

建议烫金文件这样做：

1. 烫金图层单独做专色，不要混在CMYK里。

1. 尽量使用矢量图形。

1. 避免太细的线条。

1. 避免太小的反白字。

1. 烫金区域不要太靠近折线、压痕线和裁切边。

1. 多色烫金之间要预留套准公差。

1. 如果有凹凸压纹，要提前考虑版位误差。

1. 大面积烫金一定要打样。

烫金不是屏幕效果，必须考虑材料、版、压力、温度和机器公差。

## 阿里国际站成交版

For better stamping results, please provide vector artwork for the foil area.

We suggest keeping the foil design as a separate spot-color layer. Very thin lines, small reverse text and foil areas close to crease lines should be tested before production.

You can send us your artwork, and we can help check whether it is more suitable for fine-detail foil or solid-area foil.

## 自然 CTA

Send your foil artwork and substrate sample. We can help check whether the design is more suitable for fine-detail foil or solid-area foil.

## 关键词
